units.source_text: 罪與祈禱，罪與懺悔，罪與告白，罪與……嗚呼，全都是同義詞。

en.t: Sin and prayer, sin and repentance, sin and confession, sin and... ah, they are all synonyms.
What is the opposite of sin?"

units.source_text: 「罪的反義詞是蜜[2]，像蜂蜜一樣甜蜜。

en.t: "The opposite of sin is honey[2], sweet like honey.

units.source_text: 啊，肚子好餓啊，你去拿點吃的過來吧。」

en.t: Ah, I am so hungry. Go bring me something to eat."
"Can you not go get it yourself?"

units.source_text: 我平生第一次用暴怒的聲音說道。

en.t: For the first time in my life, I spoke in a voice of furious anger.

units.source_text: 「好好好，那我就到樓下去，和良子一起犯罪吧。

en.t: "All right, all right, then I will go downstairs and commit a sin with Yoshiko.
Better to do something real than keep chattering.

units.source_text: 罪的反詞是蜜豆，不，難道是蠶豆？」

en.t: The opposite of sin is mitsumame, no, could it be broad beans?"

units.source_text: 堀木已經醉得舌根發硬，語無倫次。

en.t: Horiki was already so drunk that his tongue was thick and his words made no sense.
"Do whatever you like. Get as far away as you can!"

units.source_text: 「罪與餓，餓與蠶豆，不，這是頭一次吧。」

en.t: "Sin and hunger, hunger and broad beans, no, this must be a first."

units.source_text: 堀木一邊胡言亂語，一邊站起身來。

en.t: Horiki stood up while babbling nonsense.
